prayerExcerpt.en-US: Running the course of this present life under your guidance, may we happily attain life without end.
prayerExcerpt.pt-BR: Conduzido por vós na vida presente, mereça alcançar a felicidade da vida eterna.

meta.face: A man of about sixty-five with a long, narrow face tapering to a small, rounded chin — a smooth, high forehead, very large, wide-open almond-shaped dark eyes under high, finely arched brows, a long, thin, perfectly straight nose, smooth cheeks without prominent cheekbones, a small, closed mouth; white hair cut in a neat round clerical ring (the crown shaven); a short, neat, pointed white beard and a thin white moustache; a calm, wide-eyed, gentle gaze straight ahead.
meta.basis: The eighth-century fresco in Santa Maria Antiqua (Wikipedia lead image) shows him frontal, with a long face, very large eyes, a long straight nose, a tonsure and a short pointed beard, holding a jewelled book in a red chasuble and pallium; the card follows it, aged to the end of his twenty-one-year reign. Soracte is where the legend has him hiding during the persecution.
